Description: private-ai-assistant 0.0.0-dev: private application on ECS Fargate behind an internal ALB with Cognito sign-in. Deploys into an existing customer VPC; creates no VPC, subnet, route, gateway or DNS resources.

VpcId.Description: Existing customer VPC. The stack never modifies it.

PrivateSubnetA.Description: First private subnet (routable from the corporate network).

PrivateSubnetB.Description: Second private subnet, in a different Availability Zone from PrivateSubnetA.

PrivateSubnetC.ConstraintDescription: must be empty or a subnet ID (subnet-xxxxxxxx or subnet-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx)
PrivateSubnetC.Description: Optional third private subnet in a third Availability Zone. Leave empty for two subnets.

AllowedIngressCidr.ConstraintDescription: must be empty or an IPv4 CIDR with a prefix of /8 to /32
AllowedIngressCidr.Description: Corporate client CIDR allowed to reach the internal ALB on 443. Set this and/or AllowedSourceSecurityGroupId.

AllowedSourceSecurityGroupId.Description: Optional customer-approved security group allowed to reach the internal ALB on 443.

AppHostname.ConstraintDescription: must be a lower-case DNS name, e.g. assistant.corp.example.com
AppHostname.Description: Private hostname users browse to. You create the corporate DNS record pointing at the ALB.

CertificateArn.Description: ACM certificate ARN (imported private-CA or public) covering AppHostname.

CognitoDomainPrefix.Description: Globally unique prefix for the Cognito hosted sign-in domain (public endpoint).

BedrockModelId.Description: Bedrock model ID or inference profile ID the agent invokes (model access must be enabled in this account).

CreateBedrockEndpoint.Description: Create a Bedrock Runtime interface endpoint with private DNS. Leave false if your VPC already provides one.

AlarmEmail.Description: Optional email subscribed to the alarm topic (confirm the subscription email). Other subscribers can be added to the topic later.

EnableSmokeTestPath.Description: Expose an unauthenticated, rate-limited /api/selftest (one minimal Bedrock call). For installation tests only.

Assertions.AssertDescription: Set AllowedIngressCidr and/or AllowedSourceSecurityGroupId; the application is never opened to all sources.
PrivateSubnetA and PrivateSubnetB must be different subnets.
PrivateSubnetC must differ from PrivateSubnetA and PrivateSubnetB.
PrivateSubnetA and PrivateSubnetB must belong to VpcId.

Properties.Description: private-ai-assistant Flask signing key (generated in your account; never leaves it)

Properties.GroupDescription: Internal ALB: HTTPS from approved corporate sources only

SecurityGroupEgress.Description: ALB to Cognito token and user-info endpoints (public AWS endpoints)

Properties.GroupDescription: ECS tasks: traffic from the internal ALB only

SecurityGroupEgress.Description: HTTPS to AWS APIs (ECR, S3, CloudWatch Logs, Secrets Manager, Bedrock) via endpoints or customer egress

Properties.GroupDescription: Bedrock Runtime interface endpoint: HTTPS from application tasks

Properties.Description: Pulls images, writes logs and reads the application secret
Application runtime role: Bedrock model invocation only

Properties.AlarmDescription: Application returned more than 10 HTTP 5xx responses in 5 minutes. Check api/agent logs.
At least one task failed ALB health checks for 3 minutes.
No healthy tasks behind the ALB: the application is down.
Service CPU above 85% for 15 minutes; consider raising DesiredCount.

LoadBalancerDnsName.Description: Point the corporate DNS record for AppHostname here
